scope: Independent acquired-data qualification of the constrained nonlinear PE and anatomical models. This manifest freezes the court before any Flashalign nonlinear registration is run; it is not itself an accuracy result.

candidate.source_tree_hash_contract: SHA-256 over every non-target regular file below modules/reframe4s-flashalign, sorted by repository-relative path, with each path and byte payload prefixed by its unsigned eight-byte big-endian length

split_policy.related_data_rule: All sessions, repeats, derived images and initialization replicates from one subject remain in one split and one bootstrap cluster.
split_policy.site_rule: Use site as the split and resampling cluster when site effects are part of a claim.
split_policy.audit_use: once after input hashes, candidate source, providers, initialization distribution, masks, thresholds and method configurations are sealed
split_policy.audit_reuse_rule: Any audit observation used for tuning retires this manifest and requires a new dataset split and version.

required_strata.comparison_rule: The PE field is compared only with methods given the same single-direction acquisition information and equivalent nonlinear freedom. Affine remains a required control, never the sole superiority comparator.
This stratum is never pooled with anatomically guided single-PE fitting; opposing forward distortions are defined on a common undistorted domain.
This acquisition-information stratum remains separate from both single-PE and reverse-PE analyses.

inputs: manual anatomical labels or independent landmarks
independent masks when masks enter registration
required_strata.comparison_rule: The matched nonlinear comparison must receive the same affine initialization, images, masks, thread budget and output scoring. Zero-field and affine controls are reported even when the flexible model improves.

initialization.ordinary: One fixed, independently specified moving-to-fixed world transform shared by every applicable method.
initialization.large_error: Deterministic physical perturbations stratified by translation and rotation, fixed before execution and retained in the original subject cluster.
initialization.same_affine_nonlinear_rule: All nonlinear arms receive the identical typed world-space affine. A method's own initializer is a separate complete-pipeline comparison.
initialization.failed_initialization_rule: Failure, ambiguity, invalid geometry and timeout remain rows in the original cohort denominator.

primary: independent landmark RMS, p95 and maximum error in millimetres when landmarks exist
per-structure Dice and subject-level macro Dice when labels exist
per-structure HD95 millimetres and subject-level macro HD95 when labels exist
geometry: continuous PE directional-Jacobian certificate and margin
continuous small-strain gradient certificate and margin
independent sampled singular values or Jacobian determinants
inverse roundtrip maximum and coverage on the certified scope
scoring.image_similarity_role: diagnostic only; it cannot establish anatomical accuracy

thresholds.superiority_rule: For every required cohort, the subject-clustered 95% interval must exclude zero in the favorable direction for the declared primary difference, and neither catastrophic failures nor invalid geometry may increase.
thresholds.noninferiority_rule: The unfavorable endpoint of the subject-clustered 95% interval must stay within the predeclared metric-specific margin.

statistics.cluster: subject, or site when the claim is site-generalization
statistics.reporting: Per-subject rows, failures, cohort distributions and intervals are retained; pooling never replaces stratum-specific results.

failure_accounting.denominator: Every declared subject-by-initialization-by-method row, including unavailable and failed lanes.

execution_gate.reason: No admissible sealed PE cohort is present, no unopened multi-cohort anatomical audit is present, and the source tree has no image-backed nonlinear objective adapter outside test fixtures. No nonlinear registration was executed.
